windows-destructive-policy.name: powershell-guard
windows-destructive-policy.description: Asks before destructive PowerShell or Git actions; ordinary commands stay automatic.

bash-destructive-guard.name: bash-and-file-guard
bash-destructive-guard.description: Uses pi-guard to check Bash commands and file edits for risky operations.

context-status.name: context-usage
context-status.description: Shows estimated context usage in Pi CLI; Pi App uses its built-in Context panel.

tool-budget.name: tool-budget
tool-budget.description: Keeps the initial tool list small by disabling extra LSP and browser tools.

effort.name: thinking-effort
effort.description: Adds /effort and maps thinking levels to real request budgets; --save persists a default.

pi-app-compat.name: desktop-compatibility
pi-app-compat.description: Bridges local-model metadata between Pi App 0.7.6 and Pi SDK 1.3.0.

session-telemetry.name: session-telemetry
session-telemetry.description: Records response latency, tool durations and observed thinking time in the session JSONL.

lsp-windows.name: lsp-windows
lsp-windows.description: Code diagnostics, definitions, hover, references and rename through language servers.
